name: Bac Me bamboo-tube rice
summary: Vietnam Tourism’s food page says Bac Me bamboo-tube rice. The loop page says Bac Me sticky rice. The pages do not call these one dish. Both names stay. A method is Check on arrival.
where: Bắc Mê. The four-day page names Bắc Mê as a food stop on the way back and does not say this rice is sold at that stall.
seoTitle: Bac Me rice — bamboo-tube and sticky rice
seoDescription: Bắc Mê bamboo-tube rice and Bắc Mê sticky rice both stay. A method is Check on arrival. The return stalls are a separate stop.
